train.via: Union Station GO to Niagara Falls GO

bus.via: Union Stn Bus Terminal, 81 Bay St at Lakeshore Blvd, 2nd Floor to Bus Terminal

trips.route_note: Take a GO Transit Lakeshore West train to Burlington or Aldershot, then a connecting GO bus to Niagara Falls, or a seasonal direct GO train; the whole trip is roughly 2 to 2.5 hours each way.
trips.tour_query: Niagara Falls day trip from Toronto
trips.why: The bus is the fastest option at 1h 35m and drops you near the falls.
know: Book ahead in summer as it is peak season
Best time to go is late spring to early fall
Bring a light rain layer for the mist

train.via: Toronto Union Station to St. Catharines

trips.route_note: Take a GO train or bus to Niagara Falls, then a local bus or short taxi to Niagara-on-the-Lake; total travel is about 2.5 to 3 hours each way.
trips.why: The bus is the quicker of the two at 1h 45m, though the last mile needs a local bus or short taxi.
know: Best in summer when the town and wineries are in full swing
Expect a last-mile transfer from Niagara Falls

trips.route_note: Take a VIA Rail train from Toronto Union to Stratford, about 2 to 2.5 hours each way, with the station a short walk from downtown.
trips.tour_query: Stratford Ontario day trip from Toronto
trips.why: With the train showing 10h 26m each way and no bus listed, the 119-minute drive is clearly better.
know: Best in the festival season for theatre
The station is a short walk from downtown if you do take rail
